name: Lockly Secure Pro (US)

radios.note: The lock itself uses Bluetooth; Wi-Fi comes from the Secure Link Wi-Fi Hub in the box. Newer built-in Wi-Fi editions (for example PGD728WMBE1) exist and are a different variant.

matter.note: Lockly says only designated lock versions (serial number with an N) work with Matter, and that needs the newer Secure Link hub, sold separately. CSA lists a Lockly Matter hub (PGH260); we found no Matter listing for the lock itself.

apple_home.note: Lockly says Siri and Apple Home work only on Matter-compatible lock versions with the newer hub. Depends on the unit, so not marked.

google_home.note: Lockly says the hub lets non-Matter locks use Alexa or Hey Google voice control.

alexa.note: Lockly says the hub lets non-Matter locks use Alexa or Hey Google voice control.

smartthings.note: Lockly lists SmartThings only for Matter-compatible versions with the newer hub, so it depends on the unit.

home_assistant.note: No Lockly or Home Assistant docs source found. Community posts report it working via Matter or HomeKit, which are not official.

hubRequired.note: The Bluetooth-only lock needs the included Secure Link Wi-Fi Hub for remote access and voice control; Bluetooth control works near the door.

localControl.note: No Lockly source describes local-only control.

lockFit.note: Deadbolt edition (PGD728W) replacing a US deadbolt; Lockly also sells a latch edition.

keypad.note: PIN Genie keypad on the lock, plus a 3D fingerprint sensor.

power.note: Lockly's FAQ says its Secure models use four AA batteries; we saw only the FAQ snippet, not a spec table.

summary: The Lockly Secure Pro deadbolt pairs a Bluetooth lock with a PIN Genie keypad and fingerprint sensor with an included Secure Link Wi-Fi Hub. The hub adds remote access and Alexa and Google voice control. Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter work only on certain lock versions with a newer hub sold separately. It runs on four AA batteries.
caveats: Wi-Fi comes from the included hub; the lock itself is Bluetooth.
Matter works only on units whose activation-card serial number has an N, and needs the newer Secure Link hub, sold separately.
Built-in Wi-Fi editions such as PGD728WMBE1 are separate variants and are excluded from Lockly's Matter list.
